name: apply
doc: Applies the given function to the pattern.

name: arrange
doc: Allows to arrange multiple patterns together over multiple cycles.

name: as
doc: Sets properties in a batch.

name: cat
doc: The given items are concatenated, where each one takes one cycle.

name: inhabit
doc: Picks patterns (or plain values) either from a list (by index) or a lookup table (by name).

name: keep
doc: When called on a pattern a, with a input pattern b (a.keep(b)), combines a and b such that anything defined in a, and anything defined in b that is not defined in a will be in the resulting pattern.

name: layer
doc: Layers the result of the given function(s).

name: pick
doc: Picks patterns (or plain values) either from a list (by index) or a lookup table (by name).
example: note("<0 1 2!2 3>".pick(["g a", "e f", "f g f g" , "g c d"]))

name: pickF
doc: pickF lets you use a pattern of numbers to pick which function to apply to another pattern.

name: pickmodRestart
doc: The same as pickRestart, but if you pick a number greater than the size of the list, it wraps around, rather than sticking at the maximum value.

name: pickOut
doc: Similar to pick, but it applies an outerJoin instead of an innerJoin.
example: note("<0*4 1 2*2 3*3>".pickOut(["g a", "e f", "f g f g" , "g c d"]))

name: seq
doc: Like cat, but the items are crammed into one cycle.

name: seqPLoop
doc: Similarly to arrange, allows you to arrange multiple patterns together over multiple cycles.

name: set
doc: When called on a pattern a, with a input pattern b (a.set(b)), combines a and b such that anything defined in b and anything defined in a that is not defined in b will be in the resulting pattern.

name: setDefaultJoin
doc: Sets the default method of combining events from two patterns (aka alignment) in Strudel.
example:
setDefaultJoin('mix') // also try 'in', 'out', 'squeeze', etc.
s("saw").vel("1 0.5").note("F A C E").delay("0 0.2 0.3")
snippet:
setDefaultJoin('mix') // also try 'in', 'out', 'squeeze', etc.
$: s("saw").vel("1 0.5").note("F A C E").delay("0 0.2 0.3")

name: slowcat
doc: Concatenation: combines a list of patterns, switching between them successively, one per cycle.

name: squeeze
doc: Pick from the list of values (or patterns of values) via the index using the given pattern of integers.
example: note(squeeze("<0@2 [1!2] 2>", ["g a", "f g f g" , "g a c d"]))
snippet: $: note(squeeze("<0@2 [1!2] 2>", ["g a", "f g f g" , "g a c d"]))

name: stack
doc: The given items are played at the same time at the same length.

name: superimpose
doc: Superimposes the result of the given function(s) on top of the original pattern.

name: base
doc: Creates a pattern of numbers in base b from a number or pattern of numbers limited to d digits long from the right.

name: berlin
doc: Generates a continuous pattern of berlin noise (conceived by Jame Coyne and Jade Rowland as a joke but turned out to be surprisingly cool and useful, like perlin noise but with sawtooth waves), in the…

name: binary
doc: Creates a binary pattern from a number.

name: binaryN
doc: Creates a binary pattern from a number, padded to n bits long.

name: brand
doc: A continuous pattern of 0 or 1 (binary random).

name: brandBy
doc: A continuous pattern of 0 or 1 (binary random), with a probability for the value being 1.

name: cosine
doc: A cosine signal between 0 and 1.

name: gap
doc: Does absolutely nothing, but with a given metrical 'steps'.

name: irand
doc: A continuous pattern of random integers, between 0 and n-1.
example:
// randomly select scale notes from 0 - 7 (= C to C)
n(irand(8)).struct("x x*2 x x*3").scale("C:minor")
snippet:
// randomly select scale notes from 0 - 7 (= C to C)
$: n(irand(8)).struct("x x*2 x x*3").scale("C:minor")

name: isaw
doc: A sawtooth signal between 1 and 0 (like saw, but flipped).

name: itri
doc: An inverted triangle signal between 1 and 0 (like tri, but flipped).

name: K
doc: Produces a Kabelsalat modular sound engine.
example:
note("A c e".fast(4)).transpose("<0 2 4 6 8>")
  .scale("F:minor").transpose("12")
  .s("saw")
  .K(
    // audioin().mul(sGate.adsr(0.001, 0.3, 0, 0.2)) // as effect
    saw(saw(sFreq / "2!3 16").mul(8).add(sFreq).lag("0!3 0.1")).mul(0.3) // as source
    .mul(sGate.adsr(0, 0.15, 0.5, "0.1!3 1"))
    .lpf(sGate.adsr(0, 0.2, 0.3, 0.2).mul(1).add(0))
    .add(x => x.delay(S("0.3 0.2".fast(2))).mul(0.7))
    .add(x => x.delay("0.03 [0.08 0.01] 0.01 0.013").mul(0.77)).mul(0.7)
    .add(x => x.delay(.13).mul(0.7))
    .out()
  )
snippet:
$: note("A c e".fast(4)).transpose("<0 2 4 6 8>")
  .scale("F:minor").transpose("12")
  .s("saw")
  .K(
    // audioin().mul(sGate.adsr(0.001, 0.3, 0, 0.2)) // as effect
    saw(saw(sFreq / "2!3 16").mul(8).add(sFreq).lag("0!3 0.1")).mul(0.3) // as source
    .mul(sGate.adsr(0, 0.15, 0.5, "0.1!3 1"))
    .lpf(sGate.adsr(0, 0.2, 0.3, 0.2).mul(1).add(0))
    .add(x => x.delay(S("0.3 0.2".fast(2))).mul(0.7))
    .add(x => x.delay("0.03 [0.08 0.01] 0.01 0.013").mul(0.77)).mul(0.7)
    .add(x => x.delay(.13).mul(0.7))
    .out()
  )

name: noise
doc: Adds pink noise to the mix.

name: perlin
doc: Generates a continuous pattern of perlin noise, in the range 0..1.

name: pure
doc: A discrete value that repeats once per cycle.

name: rand
doc: A continuous pattern of random numbers, between 0 and 1.

name: randL
doc: Creates a list of random numbers of the given length.

name: run
doc: A discrete pattern of numbers from 0 to n-1.

name: saw
doc: A sawtooth signal between 0 and 1.

name: signal
doc: Creates a signal given by the input function.

name: silence
doc: Does absolutely nothing.

name: sine
doc: A sine signal between 0 and 1.

name: square
doc: A square signal between 0 and 1.

name: tri
doc: A triangle signal between 0 and 1.

name: beat
doc: creates a structure pattern from divisions of a cycle especially useful for creating rhythms.

name: bite
doc: Splits a pattern into the given number of slices, and plays them according to a pattern of slice numbers.

name: brak
doc: Returns a new pattern where every other cycle is played once, twice as fast, and offset in time by one quarter of a cycle.

name: chooseInWith
doc: As with chooseWith, but the structure comes from the chosen values, rather than the pattern you're using to choose with.

name: chooseWith
doc: Choose from the list of values (or patterns of values) using the given pattern of numbers, which should be in the range of 0..1.

name: chunkBackInto
doc: Like chunkInto, but moves backwards through the chunks.
example:
sound("bd sd ht lt bd - cp lt").chunkInto(4, hurry(2))
  .bank("tr909")
snippet:
$: sound("bd sd ht lt bd - cp lt").chunkInto(4, hurry(2))
  .bank("tr909")

name: chunkInto
doc: Like chunk, but the function is applied to a looped subcycle of the source pattern.
example:
sound("bd sd ht lt bd - cp lt").chunkInto(4, hurry(2))
  .bank("tr909")
snippet:
$: sound("bd sd ht lt bd - cp lt").chunkInto(4, hurry(2))
  .bank("tr909")

name: close
doc: The same as open, but goes from 1 to 0 over one cycle, and then stays on 0 forever.
example:
sound("bd sd [- bd] sd".fast(2))
  .lpf(close.slow(4).range(300,3000)) // close envelope over 4 cycles
  .restart("x/4") // restart every 4 cycles
snippet:
$: sound("bd sd [- bd] sd".fast(2))
  .lpf(close.slow(4).range(300,3000)) // close envelope over 4 cycles
  .restart("x/4") // restart every 4 cycles

name: compress
doc: Compress each cycle into the given timespan, leaving a gap.
example:
cat(
  s("bd sd").compress(.25,.75),
  s("~ bd sd ~")
)
snippet:
$: cat(
  s("bd sd").compress(.25,.75),
  s("~ bd sd ~")
)

name: cpm
doc: Plays the pattern at the given cycles per minute.

name: cyclesPer
doc: A pattern measuring the duration of events, in cycles per event. cyclesPer doesn't have structure itself, but takes structure, and therefore event durations, from the pattern that it is combined with.

name: degradeByWith
doc: degradeByWith is like degradeBy, but with control over the random or other signal used to filter out the events.

name: early
doc: Nudge a pattern to start earlier in time.

name: euclid
doc: Changes the structure of the pattern to form an Euclidean rhythm.

name: euclidish
doc: A 'euclid' variant with an additional parameter that morphs the resulting rhythm from 0 (no morphing) to 1 (completely 'even').

name: euclidLegato
doc: Similar to euclid, but each pulse is held until the next pulse, so there will be no gaps.

name: euclidLegatoRot
doc: Similar to euclid, but each pulse is held until the next pulse, so there will be no gaps, and has an additional parameter for 'rotating' the resulting sequence.

name: euclidRot
doc: Like euclid, but has an additional parameter for 'rotating' the resulting sequence.
example:
// A Samba rhythm necklace from Brazil
note("c3").euclidRot(3,16,14)
snippet:
// A Samba rhythm necklace from Brazil
$: note("c3").euclidRot(3,16,14)

name: fast
doc: Speed up a pattern by the given factor.
example: s("bd hh sd hh").fast(2) // s("[bd hh sd hh]*2")
snippet: $: s("bd hh sd hh").fast(2) // s("[bd hh sd hh]*2")

name: fastGap
doc: speeds up a pattern like fast, but rather than it playing multiple times as fast would it instead leaves a gap in the remaining space of the cycle.

name: filter
doc: Filters haps using the given function.

name: filterWhen
doc: Filters haps by their begin time.

name: focus
doc: Similar to compress, but doesn't leave gaps, and the 'focus' can be bigger than a cycle.

name: hurry
doc: Both speeds up the pattern (like 'fast') and the sample playback (like 'speed').

name: inside
doc: Carries out an operation 'inside' a cycle.

name: into
doc: Breaks a pattern into pieces according to the structure of a given pattern.

name: isobite
doc: Similar to struct, but every hap in the structure pattern plays the next cycle of the main pattern.

name: iter
doc: Divides a pattern into a given number of subdivisions, plays the subdivisions in order, but increments the starting subdivision each cycle.

name: iterBack
doc: Like iter, but plays the subdivisions in reverse order.

name: jux
doc: The jux function creates strange stereo effects, by applying a function to a pattern, but only in the right-hand channel.
example: s("bd lt [~ ht] mt cp ~ bd hh").jux(rev)
snippet: $: s("bd lt [~ ht] mt cp ~ bd hh").jux(rev)

name: juxBy
doc: Jux with adjustable stereo width.
example: s("bd lt [~ ht] mt cp ~ bd hh").juxBy("<0 .5 1>/2", rev)
snippet: $: s("bd lt [~ ht] mt cp ~ bd hh").juxBy("<0 .5 1>/2", rev)

name: juxFlip
doc: Like jux, but flips the ears each cycle.
example: s("bd lt [~ ht] mt cp ~ bd hh").juxFlip(rev)
snippet: $: s("bd lt [~ ht] mt cp ~ bd hh").juxFlip(rev)

name: juxFlipBy
doc: Like juxBy, except it flips the ears each cycle.
example: s("bd lt [~ ht] mt cp ~ bd hh").juxFlipBy(".8", rev)
snippet: $: s("bd lt [~ ht] mt cp ~ bd hh").juxFlipBy(".8", rev)

name: late
doc: Nudge a pattern to start later in time.

name: linger
doc: Selects the given fraction of the pattern and repeats that part to fill the remainder of the cycle.

name: morph
doc: Takes two binary rhythms represented as lists of 1s and 0s, and a number between 0 and 1 that morphs between them.

name: open
doc: A signal that goes from 0 to 1 over one cycle, and then stays at 1 forever.
example:
sound("bd sd [- bd] sd".fast(2))
  .lpf(open.slow(4).range(300,3000)) // close envelope over 4 cycles
  .restart("x/4") // restart every 4 cycles
snippet:
$: sound("bd sd [- bd] sd".fast(2))
  .lpf(open.slow(4).range(300,3000)) // close envelope over 4 cycles
  .restart("x/4") // restart every 4 cycles

name: outside
doc: Carries out an operation 'outside' a cycle.

name: palindrome
doc: Applies rev to a pattern every other cycle, so that the pattern alternates between forwards and backwards.

name: per
doc: A pattern measuring the 'shortness' of events, or in other words, the duration of pattern events, in events per cycle. per doesn't have structure itself, but takes structure, and therefore event…

name: ply
doc: The ply function repeats each event the given number of times.

name: plyForEach
doc: The plyForEach function repeats each event the given number of times, applying the given function to each event.

name: plyWith
doc: The plyWith function repeats each event the given number of times, applying the given function to each event.

name: press
doc: Syncopates a rhythm, by shifting each event halfway into its timespan.

name: pressBy
doc: Like press, but allows you to specify the amount by which each event is shifted. pressBy(0.5) is the same as press, while pressBy(1/3) shifts each event by a third of its timespan.

name: repeatCycles
doc: Repeats each cycle the given number of times.

name: rev
doc: Reverse all cycles in a pattern.

name: revv
doc: Reverse a whole pattern.

name: ribbon
doc: Loops the pattern inside an offset for cycles.

name: scramble
doc: Slices a pattern into the given number of parts, then plays those parts at random.

name: segment
doc: Samples the pattern at a rate of n events per cycle.

name: setcpm
doc: Changes the global tempo to the given cycles per minute.

name: shuffle
doc: Slices a pattern into the given number of parts, then plays those parts in random order.

name: slow
doc: Slow down a pattern over the given number of cycles.
example: s("bd hh sd hh").slow(2) // s("[bd hh sd hh]/2")
snippet: $: s("bd hh sd hh").slow(2) // s("[bd hh sd hh]/2")

name: swing
doc: Shorthand for swingBy with 1/3.

name: swingBy
doc: The function swingBy x n breaks each cycle into n slices, and then delays events in the second half of each slice by the amount x, which is relative to the size of the (half) slice.

name: tag
doc: Tags each Hap with an identifier.
example:
s("saw!16").note("F1")
  .lpf(tri.range(40, 80).slow(4)).lpenv(5).lpq(4).lpd(0.15)
  .when(rand.late(0.1).gte(0.5), x => x.transpose("12").tag('altered'))
  .when(rand.late(0.2).gte(0.5), x => x.s("square").tag('altered'))
  .when("<0 1>", x => x.filter((hap) => hap.hasTag('altered')))
snippet:
$: s("saw!16").note("F1")
  .lpf(tri.range(40, 80).slow(4)).lpenv(5).lpq(4).lpd(0.15)
  .when(rand.late(0.1).gte(0.5), x => x.transpose("12").tag('altered'))
  .when(rand.late(0.2).gte(0.5), x => x.s("square").tag('altered'))
  .when("<0 1>", x => x.filter((hap) => hap.hasTag('altered')))

name: zoom
doc: Plays a portion of a pattern, specified by the beginning and end of a time span.
example:
s("bd*2 hh*3 [sd bd]*2 perc").zoom(0.25, 0.75)
// s("hh*3 [sd bd]*2") // equivalent
snippet:
$: s("bd*2 hh*3 [sd bd]*2 perc").zoom(0.25, 0.75)
// s("hh*3 [sd bd]*2") // equivalent

name: arp
doc: Selects indices in in stacked notes.

name: arpWith
doc: Selects indices in in stacked notes.

name: chunk
doc: Divides a pattern into a given number of parts, then cycles through those parts in turn, applying the given function to each part in turn (one part per cycle).

name: chunkBack
doc: Like chunk, but cycles through the parts in reverse order.

name: every
doc: An alias for firstOf.

name: fastChunk
doc: Like chunk, but the cycles of the source pattern aren't repeated for each set of chunks.

name: firstOf
doc: Applies the given function every n cycles, starting from the first cycle.

name: hush
doc: Silences a pattern.

name: invert
doc: Swaps 1s and 0s in a binary pattern.

name: lastOf
doc: Applies the given function every n cycles, starting from the last cycle.

name: mask
doc: Returns silence when mask is 0 or "~".

name: reset
doc: Resets the pattern to the start of the cycle for each onset of the reset pattern.

name: restart
doc: Restarts the pattern for each onset of the restart pattern.

name: struct
doc: Applies the given structure to the pattern.
example:
note("c,eb,g")
  .struct("x ~ x ~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~")
  .slow(2)
snippet:
$: note("c,eb,g")
  .struct("x ~ x ~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~ ~ x ~ x ~ ~")
  .slow(2)

name: when
doc: Applies the given function whenever the given pattern is in a true state.

name: almostAlways
doc: Shorthand for .sometimesBy(0.9, fn).

name: almostNever
doc: Shorthand for .sometimesBy(0.1, fn).

name: always
doc: Shorthand for .sometimesBy(1, fn) (always calls fn).

name: choose
doc: Chooses randomly from the given list of elements.

name: chooseCycles
doc: Picks one of the elements at random each cycle.

name: degrade
doc: Randomly removes 50% of events from the pattern.

name: degradeBy
doc: Randomly removes events from the pattern by a given amount.

name: never
doc: Shorthand for .sometimesBy(0, fn) (never calls fn).

name: often
doc: Shorthand for .sometimesBy(0.75, fn).

name: rarely
doc: Shorthand for .sometimesBy(0.25, fn).

name: someCycles
doc: Shorthand for .someCyclesBy(0.5, fn).

name: someCyclesBy
doc: Randomly applies the given function by the given probability on a cycle by cycle basis.

name: sometimes
doc: Applies the given function with a 50% chance.

name: sometimesBy
doc: Randomly applies the given function by the given probability.

name: undegrade
doc: Inverse of degrade: Randomly removes 50% of events from the pattern.

name: undegradeBy
doc: Inverse of degradeBy: Randomly removes events from the pattern by a given amount.

name: wchoose
doc: Chooses randomly from the given list of elements by giving a probability to each element.

name: wchooseCycles
doc: Picks one of the elements at random each cycle by giving a probability to each element.

name: echo
doc: Superimpose and offset multiple times, gradually decreasing the velocity.

name: echoWith
doc: Superimpose and offset multiple times, applying the given function each time.

name: off
doc: Superimposes the function result on top of the original pattern, delayed by the given time.

name: stut
doc: (Deprecated) Like echo, but the last 2 parameters are flipped.

name: contract
doc: (Experimental) Contracts the step size of the pattern by the given factor.

name: drop
doc: (Experimental) Drops the given number of steps from a pattern.

name: expand
doc: (Experimental) Expands the step size of the pattern by the given factor.

name: extend
doc: (Experimental) extend is similar to fast in that it increases its density, but it also increases the step count accordingly.
example:
stepcat(
  sound("bd bd - <cp hh>").extend(2),
  sound("bd - sd -")
).pace(8)
snippet:
$: stepcat(
  sound("bd bd - <cp hh>").extend(2),
  sound("bd - sd -")
).pace(8)

name: grow
doc: (Experimental) Progressively grows the pattern by 'n' steps until the full pattern is played, or if a second value is given (using mininotation list syntax with :), that number of times.

name: pace
doc: (Experimental) Speeds a pattern up or down, to fit to the given number of steps per cycle.
example:
sound("bd sd cp").pace(4)
// The same as sound("{bd sd cp}%4") or sound("<bd sd cp>*4")
snippet:
$: sound("bd sd cp").pace(4)
// The same as sound("{bd sd cp}%4") or sound("<bd sd cp>*4")

name: polymeter
doc: (Experimental) Aligns the steps of the patterns, creating polymeters.
example:
// The same as note("{c eb g, c2 g2}%6")
polymeter("c eb g", "c2 g2").note()
snippet:
// The same as note("{c eb g, c2 g2}%6")
$: polymeter("c eb g", "c2 g2").note()

name: replicate
doc: (Experimental) replicate is similar to extend, except that replicate will "replicate" the thing being extended.
example:
stepcat(
  sound("bd bd - <cp hh>").replicate(2),
  sound("bd - sd -")
).pace(8)
snippet:
$: stepcat(
  sound("bd bd - <cp hh>").replicate(2),
  sound("bd - sd -")
).pace(8)

name: shrink
doc: (Experimental) Progressively shrinks the pattern by 'n' steps until there's nothing left, or if a second value is given (using mininotation list syntax with :), that number of times.

name: stackCenter
doc: The input patterns are aligned to the right, with silence padded to the shorter pattern(s) in the initial steps if there's a stepcount disparity.

name: stackLeft
doc: The input patterns are aligned to the left, with silence padded to the shorter pattern(s) in the final steps if there's a stepcount disparity.

name: stackRepeat
doc: Shorthand for pm(patterns).pace(m) where m is the max step count in the input patterns.

name: stackRight
doc: The input patterns are aligned to the right, with silence padded to the shorter pattern(s) in the initial steps if there's a stepcount disparity.

name: stepalt
doc: (Experimental) Concatenates patterns stepwise, according to an inferred 'steps per cycle'.
example:
stepalt(["bd cp", "mt"], "bd").sound()
// The same as "bd cp bd mt bd".sound()
snippet:
$: stepalt(["bd cp", "mt"], "bd").sound()
// The same as "bd cp bd mt bd".sound()

name: stepcat
doc: 'Concatenates' patterns like fastcat, but proportional to a number of steps per cycle.

name: take
doc: (Experimental) Takes the given number of steps from a pattern (dropping the rest).
example:
"bd cp ht mt".take("2").sound()
// The same as "bd cp".sound()
snippet:
$: "bd cp ht mt".take("2").sound()
// The same as "bd cp".sound()

name: tour
doc: (Experimental) Inserts a pattern into a list of patterns.
example:
"[c g]".tour("e f", "e f g", "g f e c").note()
.sound("folkharp")
.pace(8)
snippet:
$: "[c g]".tour("e f", "e f g", "g f e c").note()
.sound("folkharp")
.pace(8)

name: zip
doc: (Experimental) 'zips' together the steps of the provided patterns.
example:
zip("e f", "e f g", "g [f e] a f4 c").note()
.sound("folkharp")
.pace(8)
snippet:
$: zip("e f", "e f g", "g [f e] a f4 c").note()
.sound("folkharp")
.pace(8)

name: add
doc: Assumes a pattern of numbers.

name: ceil
doc: Assumes a numerical pattern.

name: floor
doc: Assumes a numerical pattern.

name: mul
doc: Multiplies each number by the given factor.

name: range
doc: Assumes a numerical pattern, containing unipolar values in the range 0 .. 1.

name: range2
doc: Assumes a numerical pattern, containing bipolar values in the range -1 .. 1 Returns a new pattern with values scaled to the given min/max range.

name: rangex
doc: Assumes a numerical pattern, containing unipolar values in the range 0 .. 1 Returns a new pattern with values scaled to the given min/max range, following an exponential curve.

name: ratio
doc: Allows dividing numbers via list notation using ":".

name: round
doc: Assumes a numerical pattern.

name: seed
doc: Change the seed for random signals.
example:
$: s("hh*4").degrade();
$: s("bd*4").degrade().seed(1); // Will degrade different events from the hi-hat
snippet:
$: s("hh*4").degrade();
$: s("bd*4").degrade().seed(1); // Will degrade different events from the hi-hat

name: sub
doc: Like add, but the given numbers are subtracted.
example:
n("0 2 4".sub("<0 1 2 3>")).scale("C4:minor")
// See add for more information.
snippet:
$: n("0 2 4".sub("<0 1 2 3>")).scale("C4:minor")
// See add for more information.

name: useRNG
doc: Sets which random number generator to use.

name: register
doc: Registers a new pattern method.

name: withValue
doc: Returns a new pattern, with the function applied to the value of each hap.

name: addVoicings
doc: Adds a new custom voicing dictionary.

name: anchor
doc: The top note to align the voicing to.

name: chord
doc: The chord to voice.
example: chord("<Am C D F Am E Am E>").voicing()
snippet: $: chord("<Am C D F Am E Am E>").voicing()

name: dictionary
doc: Which dictionary to use for the voicings.
example:
addVoicings('house', {
'': ['7 12 16', '0 7 16', '4 7 12'],
'm': ['0 3 7']
})
chord("<Am C D F Am E Am E>")
.dict('house').anchor(66)
.voicing().room(.5)
snippet:
addVoicings('house', {
'': ['7 12 16', '0 7 16', '4 7 12'],
'm': ['0 3 7']
})
$: chord("<Am C D F Am E Am E>")
.dict('house').anchor(66)
.voicing().room(.5)

name: edoScale
doc: Turns numbers into notes in the given EDO scale (zero indexed).

name: ftranspose
doc: Frequency transpose.

name: i
doc: Selects the given degree.

name: mode
doc: How the voicing is aligned to the anchor.

name: note
doc: Plays the given note name or midi number.

name: octaves
doc: How many octaves are voicing steps spread apart, defaults to 1.
example: chord("<Am C D F Am E Am E>").octaves("<2 4>").voicing()
snippet: $: chord("<Am C D F Am E Am E>").octaves("<2 4>").voicing()

name: offset
doc: Sets how the voicing is offset from the anchored position.
example: chord("<Am C D F Am E Am E>").offset("<0 1 2 3 4 5>") // alter the voicing each time
snippet: $: chord("<Am C D F Am E Am E>").offset("<0 1 2 3 4 5>") // alter the voicing each time

name: rootNotes
doc: Maps the chords of the incoming pattern to root notes in the given octave.

name: scale
doc: Turns numbers into notes in the scale (zero indexed) or quantizes notes to a scale.

name: scaleTranspose
doc: Transposes notes inside the scale by the number of steps.

name: transpose
doc: Change the pitch of each value by the given amount.

name: tune
doc: (Deprecated) Assumes pattern contains numerical scale degrees on the i control (see examples below).

name: voicing
doc: Turns chord symbols into voicings.

name: voicings
doc: DEPRECATED: still works, but it is recommended you use .voicing instead (without s).
example: stack("<C^7 A7 Dm7 G7>".voicings('lefthand'), "<C3 A2 D3 G2>").note()
snippet: $: stack("<C^7 A7 Dm7 G7>".voicings('lefthand'), "<C3 A2 D3 G2>").note()

name: withBase
doc: Assumes pattern of frequencies tuned to some base frequency, such as the output of xen Because xen defaults to 220Hz, so will withBase. but you can specify a different original base with the standard…

name: xen
doc: Assumes a numerical pattern of scale steps, and a scale.

name: accelerate
doc: A pattern of numbers that speed up (or slow down) samples while they play.

name: bank
doc: Select the sound bank to use.
example: s("bd sd [~ bd] sd").bank('RolandTR909') // = s("RolandTR909_bd RolandTR909_sd")
snippet: $: s("bd sd [~ bd] sd").bank('RolandTR909') // = s("RolandTR909_bd RolandTR909_sd")

name: begin
doc: A pattern of numbers from 0 to 1.

name: chop
doc: Cuts each sample into the given number of parts, allowing you to explore a technique known as 'granular synthesis'.
example:
samples({ rhodes: 'https://cdn.freesound.org/previews/132/132051_316502-lq.mp3' })
s("rhodes")
 .chop(4)
 .rev() // reverse order of chops
 .loopAt(2) // fit sample into 2 cycles
snippet:
samples({ rhodes: 'https://cdn.freesound.org/previews/132/132051_316502-lq.mp3' })
$: s("rhodes")
 .chop(4)
 .rev() // reverse order of chops
 .loopAt(2) // fit sample into 2 cycles

name: end
doc: The same as .begin, but cuts off the end off each sample.

name: fit
doc: Makes the sample fit its event duration.

name: getDuration
doc: Returns the duration, in seconds, of the given sample.
excluded: the example fetches a sample map from the network (the tests run offline)

name: loop
doc: Loops the sample.

name: loopAt
doc: Makes the sample fit the given number of cycles by changing the speed.

name: loopAtCps
doc: Makes the sample fit the given number of cycles and cps value, by changing the speed. deprecated: use loopAt or fit instead, together with setCps / setCpm.

name: loopBegin
doc: Begin to loop at a specific point in the sample (inbetween begin and end).

name: loopEnd
doc: End the looping section at a specific point in the sample (inbetween begin and end).

name: n
doc: Selects the given index.

name: s
doc: Select a sound / sample by name.

name: samples
doc: Loads a collection of samples to use with s.
excluded: samples() is a stand-in that refuses until Task 3.16

name: scrub
doc: Allows you to scrub an audio file like a tape loop by passing values that represents the position in the audio file in the optional array syntax ex: "0.5:2", the second value controls the speed of…
excluded: the example loads its sample with samples()

name: slice
doc: Chops samples into the given number of slices, triggering those slices with a given pattern of slice numbers.
excluded: the example loads its samples with samples()

name: speed
doc: Changes the speed of sample playback, i.e. a cheap way of changing pitch.

name: splice
doc: Works the same as slice, but changes the playback speed of each slice to match the duration of its step.
excluded: the example loads its samples with samples()

name: stretch
doc: Changes the pitch of the sample without changing its speed.

name: striate
doc: Cuts each sample into the given number of parts, triggering progressive portions of each sample at each loop.

name: bmod
doc: Modulates with the output from a given bus.

name: byteBeatExpression
doc: Create byte beats with custom expressions.

name: byteBeatStartTime
doc: Create byte beats with custom expressions.

name: clip
doc: Multiplies the duration with the given number.

name: coarse
doc: Fake-resampling for lowering the sample rate.

name: compressor
doc: Dynamics Compressor.

name: crush
doc: Bit crusher effect.

name: cut
doc: In the style of classic drum-machines, cut will stop a playing sample as soon as another samples with in same cutgroup is to be played.

name: density
doc: crackle noise density.

name: distortvol
doc: Postgain for waveshaping distortion.

name: duration
doc: Sets the duration of the event in cycles.

name: FX
doc: Establishes an FX chain.
example:
$: s("[sbd <hh [bd | lt | oh]>]*4").dec(.4)
  .FX(
    phaser(0.5).gain(2),
    bpf(800),
    distort(1.3),
    room(0.2),
    delay(0.5).gain(1.25),
    distort(0.3),
  ).fxr(1.7) // sets release time of effects (like delay)
snippet:
$: s("[sbd <hh [bd | lt | oh]>]*4").dec(.4)
  .FX(
    phaser(0.5).gain(2),
    bpf(800),
    distort(1.3),
    room(0.2),
    delay(0.5).gain(1.25),
    distort(0.3),
  ).fxr(1.7) // sets release time of effects (like delay)

name: orbit
doc: An orbit is a global parameter context for patterns.

name: pan
doc: Sets position in stereo.

name: partials
doc: Scale the magnitude of the harmonics of one of the core synths ('sine', 'tri', 'saw', ..).

name: phaser
doc: Phaser audio effect that approximates popular guitar pedals.

name: phasercenter
doc: The center frequency of the phaser in HZ.

name: phases
doc: Rotates the harmonics of one of the core synths ('sine', 'tri', 'saw', 'user', ..) by a list of phases.
excluded: the example gives `partials` a control object where a list belongs: partials(partials([1, 1, 1]))

name: pw
doc: Controls the pulsewidth of the pulse oscillator.

name: setMaxPolyphony
doc: Set the max polyphony.

name: spread
doc: Set the stereo pan spread for supported oscillators.
example: note("d f a a# a d3").fast(2).s("supersaw").spread("<0 .3 1>")
snippet: $: note("d f a a# a d3").fast(2).s("supersaw").spread("<0 .3 1>")

name: transient
doc: Transient shaper.

name: unison
doc: Set number of stacked voices for supported oscillators.
example: note("d f a a# a d3").fast(2).s("supersaw").unison("<1 2 7>")
snippet: $: note("d f a a# a d3").fast(2).s("supersaw").unison("<1 2 7>")

name: vowel
doc: Formant filter to make things sound like vowels.

name: amp
doc: Like gain, but linear.

name: gain
doc: Controls the gain by an exponential amount.

name: postgain
doc: Gain applied after all effects have been processed.

name: setGainCurve
doc: Apply a function to all gains provided in patterns.
example:
setGainCurve((x) => x * x) // quadratic gain
s("bd*4").gain(0.5) // equivalent to 0.25 gain normally
snippet:
setGainCurve((x) => x * x) // quadratic gain
$: s("bd*4").gain(0.5) // equivalent to 0.25 gain normally

name: velocity
doc: Sets the velocity from 0 to 1.

name: xfade
doc: Cross-fades between left and right from 0 to 1.

name: adsr
doc: ADSR envelope: Combination of Attack, Decay, Sustain, and Release.

name: attack
doc: Amplitude envelope attack time: Specifies how long it takes for the sound to reach its peak value, relative to the onset.

name: decay
doc: Amplitude envelope decay time: the time it takes after the attack time to reach the sustain level.

name: duckattack
doc: The time required for the ducked signal(s) to return to their normal volume.

name: duckonset
doc: The time required for the ducked signal(s) to reach their lowest volume.

name: env
doc: Configures an envelope.

name: panchor
doc: Sets the range anchor of the envelope.

name: pattack
doc: Attack time of pitch envelope.

name: pcurve
doc: Curve of envelope.

name: pdecay
doc: Decay time of pitch envelope.

name: penv
doc: Amount of pitch envelope.

name: prelease
doc: Release time of pitch envelope.
example:
note("<c eb g bb> ~")
.release(.5) // to hear the pitch release
.prelease("<0 .1 .25 .5>")
snippet:
$: note("<c eb g bb> ~")
.release(.5) // to hear the pitch release
.prelease("<0 .1 .25 .5>")

name: release
doc: Amplitude envelope release time: The time it takes after the offset to go from sustain level to zero.

name: sustain
doc: Amplitude envelope sustain level: The level which is reached after attack / decay, being sustained until the offset.

name: bpattack
doc: Sets the attack duration for the bandpass filter envelope.

name: bpdecay
doc: Sets the decay duration for the bandpass filter envelope.

name: bpdepthfrequency
doc: Depth of the LFO for the bandpass filter, in HZ.

name: bpenv
doc: Sets the bandpass filter envelope modulation depth.

name: bpf
doc: Sets the center frequency of the band-pass filter.

name: bpq
doc: Sets the band-pass q-factor (resonance).

name: bprelease
doc: Sets the release time for the bandpass filter envelope.

name: bpsustain
doc: Sets the sustain amplitude for the bandpass filter envelope.

name: djf
doc: DJ filter, below 0.5 is low pass filter, above is high pass filter.

name: drive
doc: Filter overdrive for supported filter types.
example: note("{f g g c d a a#}%16".sub(17)).s("supersaw").lpenv(8).lpf(150).lpq(.8).ftype('ladder').drive("<.5 4>")
snippet: $: note("{f g g c d a a#}%16".sub(17)).s("supersaw").lpenv(8).lpf(150).lpq(.8).ftype('ladder').drive("<.5 4>")

name: fanchor
doc: controls the center of the filter envelope.
example:
note("{f g g c d a a#}%8").s("sawtooth").lpf("{1000}%2")
.lpenv(8).fanchor("<0 .5 1>")
snippet:
$: note("{f g g c d a a#}%8").s("sawtooth").lpf("{1000}%2")
.lpenv(8).fanchor("<0 .5 1>")

name: ftype
doc: Sets the filter type.
example: note("{f g g c d a a#}%8").s("sawtooth").lpenv(4).lpf(500).ftype("<0 1 2>").lpq(1)
snippet: $: note("{f g g c d a a#}%8").s("sawtooth").lpenv(4).lpf(500).ftype("<0 1 2>").lpq(1)

name: hpattack
doc: Sets the attack duration for the highpass filter envelope.

name: hpdecay
doc: Sets the decay duration for the highpass filter envelope.

name: hpdepthfrequency
doc: Depth of the LFO for the hipass filter, in hz.

name: hpenv
doc: Sets the highpass filter envelope modulation depth.

name: hpf
doc: Applies the cutoff frequency of the high-pass filter.

name: hpq
doc: Controls the high-pass q-value.

name: hprelease
doc: Sets the release time for the highpass filter envelope.

name: hpsustain
doc: Sets the sustain amplitude for the highpass filter envelope.

name: lpattack
doc: Sets the attack duration for the lowpass filter envelope.

name: lpdecay
doc: Sets the decay duration for the lowpass filter envelope.

name: lpdepth
doc: Depth of the LFO for the lowpass filter.

name: lpdepthfrequency
doc: Depth of the LFO for the lowpass filter, in HZ.

name: lpenv
doc: Sets the lowpass filter envelope modulation depth.

name: lpf
doc: Applies the cutoff frequency of the low-pass filter.

name: lpq
doc: Controls the low-pass q-value.

name: lprate
doc: Rate of the LFO for the lowpass filter.

name: lprelease
doc: Sets the release time for the lowpass filter envelope.

name: lpsustain
doc: Sets the sustain amplitude for the lowpass filter envelope.

name: lpsync
doc: Cycle-synced rate of the LFO for the lowpass filter.

name: distort
doc: Wave shaping distortion.

name: distorttype
doc: Type of waveshaping distortion to apply.

name: shape
doc: (Deprecated) Wave shaping distortion.

name: chorus
doc: mix control for the chorus effect.

name: detune
doc: Set detune for stacked voices of supported oscillators.
example: note("d f a a# a d3").fast(2).s("supersaw").detune("<.1 .2 .5 24.1>")
snippet: $: note("d f a a# a d3").fast(2).s("supersaw").detune("<.1 .2 .5 24.1>")

name: freq
doc: Set frequency of sound.

name: getFrequency
doc: Given a hap, returns the frequency of the note or freq, if defined.

name: lfo
doc: Configures an LFO.

name: phasersweep
doc: The frequency sweep range of the lfo for the phaser effect.

name: pwrate
doc: Controls the lfo rate for the pulsewidth of the pulse oscillator.

name: pwsweep
doc: Controls the lfo sweep for the pulsewidth of the pulse oscillator.

name: tremolo
doc: Modulate the amplitude of a sound with a continuous waveform.

name: tremolodepth
doc: Depth of amplitude modulation.

name: tremolophase
doc: Alter the phase of the modulation waveform.

name: tremoloshape
doc: Shape of amplitude modulation.
example: note("{f g c d}%16").tremsync(4).tremoloshape("<sine tri square>").s("sawtooth")
snippet: $: note("{f g c d}%16").tremsync(4).tremoloshape("<sine tri square>").s("sawtooth")

name: tremoloskew
doc: Alter the shape of the modulation waveform.

name: tremolosync
doc: Modulate the amplitude of a sound with a continuous waveform.

name: vib
doc: Applies a vibrato to the frequency of the oscillator.

name: vibmod
doc: Sets the vibrato depth in semitones.

name: fm
doc: Sets the Frequency Modulation of the synth.
example:
note("c e g b g e")
.fm("<0 1 2 8 32>")
._scope()
snippet:
$: note("c e g b g e")
.fm("<0 1 2 8 32>")
._scope()

name: fmattack
doc: Attack time for the FM envelope: time it takes to reach maximum modulation.
example:
note("c e g b g e")
.fm(4)
.fmattack("<0 .05 .1 .2>")
._scope()
snippet:
$: note("c e g b g e")
.fm(4)
.fmattack("<0 .05 .1 .2>")
._scope()

name: fmdecay
doc: Decay time for the FM envelope: seconds until the sustain level is reached after the attack phase.
example:
note("c e g b g e")
.fm(4)
.fmdecay("<.01 .05 .1 .2>")
.fmsustain(.4)
._scope()
snippet:
$: note("c e g b g e")
.fm(4)
.fmdecay("<.01 .05 .1 .2>")
.fmsustain(.4)
._scope()

name: fmenv
doc: Ramp type of fm envelope.
example:
note("c e g b g e")
.fm(4)
.fmdecay(.2)
.fmsustain(0)
.fmenv("<exp lin>")
._scope()
snippet:
$: note("c e g b g e")
.fm(4)
.fmdecay(.2)
.fmsustain(0)
.fmenv("<exp lin>")
._scope()

name: fmh
doc: Sets the Frequency Modulation Harmonicity Ratio.
example:
note("c e g b g e")
.fm(4)
.fmh("<1 2 1.5 1.61>")
._scope()
snippet:
$: note("c e g b g e")
.fm(4)
.fmh("<1 2 1.5 1.61>")
._scope()

name: fmsustain
doc: Sustain level for the FM envelope: how much modulation is applied after the decay phase.
example:
note("c e g b g e")
.fm(4)
.fmdecay(.1)
.fmsustain("<1 .75 .5 0>")
._scope()
snippet:
$: note("c e g b g e")
.fm(4)
.fmdecay(.1)
.fmsustain("<1 .75 .5 0>")
._scope()

name: fmwave
doc: Waveform of the fm modulator.

name: warp
doc: Amount of warp (alteration of the waveform) to apply to the wavetable oscillator.

name: warpmode
doc: Type of warp (alteration of the waveform) to apply to the wavetable oscillator.
example:
s("morgana").bank("wt_digital").seg(8).note("F1").warp("0 0.25 0.5 0.75 1")
  .warpmode("<asym bendp spin logistic sync wormhole brownian>*2")
snippet:
$: s("morgana").bank("wt_digital").seg(8).note("F1").warp("0 0.25 0.5 0.75 1")
  .warpmode("<asym bendp spin logistic sync wormhole brownian>*2")

name: wt
doc: Position in the wavetable of the wavetable oscillator.

name: wtphaserand
doc: Amount of randomness of the initial phase of the wavetable oscillator.

name: delay
doc: Sets the level of the delay signal.

name: delayfeedback
doc: Sets the level of the signal that is fed back into the delay.

name: delaysync
doc: Sets the time of the delay effect in cycles.

name: delaytime
doc: Sets the time of the delay effect in seconds.

name: duckdepth
doc: The amount of ducking applied to target orbit.

name: duckorbit
doc: Modulate the amplitude of an orbit to create a "sidechain" like effect.

name: irbegin
doc: Sets the beginning of the IR response sample.
excluded: the example loads its impulse response with samples()

name: iresponse
doc: Sets the sample to use as an impulse response for the reverb.

name: irspeed
doc: Sets speed of the sample for the impulse response.
excluded: the example loads its impulse response with samples()

name: room
doc: Sets the level of reverb.

name: roomdim
doc: Reverb lowpass frequency at -60dB (in hertz).

name: roomfade
doc: Reverb fade time (in seconds).

name: roomlp
doc: Reverb lowpass starting frequency (in hertz).

name: roomsize
doc: Sets the room size of the reverb, see room.

name: drawLine
doc: Intended for a debugging, drawLine renders the pattern as a string, where each character represents the same time span.

name: fscope
params: color, scale, pos, lean, min, max
doc: Renders an oscilloscope for the frequency domain of the audio signal.

name: log
doc: Writes the content of the current event to the console (visible in the side menu).

name: logValues
doc: A simplified version of log which writes all "values" (various configurable parameters) within the event to the console (visible in the side menu).

name: markcss
doc: Overrides the css of highlighted events.

name: pianoroll
params: options, cycles, playhead, vertical, labels, flipTime, ...
doc: Visualises a pattern as a scrolling 'pianoroll', displayed in the background of the editor.

name: pitchwheel
params: hapcircles, circle, edo, root, thickness, hapRadius, ...
doc: Renders a pitch circle to visualize frequencies within one octave.

name: print
doc: Prints the values of a pattern's events.

name: scope
params: config, align, color, thickness, scale, pos, ...
doc: Renders an oscilloscope for the time domain of the audio signal.

name: spectrum
doc: Renders a spectrum analyzer for the incoming audio signal.

name: spiral
params: options, stretch, size, thickness, cap, inset, ...
doc: Displays a spiral visual.

name: defaultmidimap
doc: configures the default midimap, which is used when no "midimap" port is set.

name: midibend
doc: MIDI pitch bend: Sends a MIDI pitch bend message.

name: midichan
doc: MIDI channel: Sets the MIDI channel for the event.

name: midicmd
doc: MIDI command: Sends a MIDI command message.

name: midikeys
doc: MIDI keyboard: Opens a MIDI input port to receive MIDI keyboard messages.

name: midimaps
doc: Adds midimaps to the registry.
example:
midimaps({ mymap: { lpf: 74 } })
$: note("c a f e")
.lpf(sine.slow(4))
.midimap('mymap')
.midi()
snippet:
midimaps({ mymap: { lpf: 74 } })
$: note("c a f e")
.lpf(sine.slow(4))
.midimap('mymap')
.midi()

name: midin
doc: MIDI input: Opens a MIDI input port to receive MIDI control change messages.
example:
const cc = await midin('IAC Driver Bus 1')
note("c a f e").lpf(cc(0).range(0, 1000)).lpq(cc(1).range(0, 10)).sound("sawtooth")
snippet:
const cc = await midin('IAC Driver Bus 1')
$: note("c a f e").lpf(cc(0).range(0, 1000)).lpq(cc(1).range(0, 10)).sound("sawtooth")

name: midiport
doc: MIDI port: Sets the MIDI port for the event.

name: miditouch
doc: MIDI key after touch: Sends a MIDI key after touch message.

name: nrpnn
doc: MIDI NRPN non-registered parameter number: Sends a MIDI NRPN non-registered parameter number message.

name: nrpv
doc: MIDI NRPN non-registered parameter value: Sends a MIDI NRPN non-registered parameter value message.

name: sysex
doc: MIDI sysex: Sends a MIDI sysex message.

name: sysexdata
doc: MIDI sysex data: Sends a MIDI sysex message.

name: sysexid
doc: MIDI sysex ID: Sends a MIDI sysex identifier message.

name: absoluteOrientationAlpha
doc: The device's absolute orientation alpha value ranges from 0 to 1.

name: absoluteOrientationBeta
doc: The device's absolute orientation beta value ranges from 0 to 1.

name: absoluteOrientationGamma
doc: The device's absolute orientation gamma value ranges from 0 to 1.

name: accelerationX
doc: The accelerometer's x-axis value ranges from 0 to 1.

name: accelerationY
doc: The accelerometer's y-axis value ranges from 0 to 1.

name: accelerationZ
doc: The accelerometer's z-axis value ranges from 0 to 1.

name: channels
doc: Allows you to set the output channels on the interface.

name: dough
doc: Uses dough as the audio engine. more info at https://dough.strudel.cc.

name: gravityX
doc: The device's gravity x-axis value ranges from 0 to 1.

name: gravityY
doc: The device's gravity y-axis value ranges from 0 to 1.

name: gravityZ
doc: The device's gravity z-axis value ranges from 0 to 1.

name: initDough
doc: initializes dough ahead of time. you don't need to use this, but if you do, you can await it, so dough is ready before the pattern starts.

name: keyDown
doc: returns true when a key or array of keys is held Key name reference.

name: midi
doc: MIDI output: Opens a MIDI output port.

name: mousex
doc: The mouse's x position value ranges from 0 to 1.

name: mousey
doc: The mouse's y position value ranges from 0 to 1.

name: onSchedule
doc: Attaches a function that is called for each hap onset.

name: onTriggerTime
doc: make something happen on event time uses browser timeout which is innacurate for audio tasks.

name: orientationAlpha
doc: The device's orientation alpha value ranges from 0 to 1.

name: orientationBeta
doc: The device's orientation beta value ranges from 0 to 1.

name: orientationGamma
doc: The device's orientation gamma value ranges from 0 to 1.

name: oschost
doc: The host to send open sound control messages to.

name: oscport
doc: The port to send open sound control messages to.

name: progNum
doc: MIDI program number: Sends a MIDI program change message.

name: rotationAlpha
doc: The device's rotation around the alpha-axis value ranges from 0 to 1.

name: rotationBeta
doc: The device's rotation around the beta-axis value ranges from 0 to 1.

name: rotationGamma
doc: The device's rotation around the gamma-axis value ranges from 0 to 1.

name: whenKey
doc: Do something on a keypress, or array of keypresses Key name reference.

name: dry
doc: Set dryness of reverb.

name: fadeTime
doc: Used when using begin/end or chop/striate and friends, to change the fade out time of the 'grain' envelope.

name: leslie
doc: Emulation of a Leslie speaker: speakers rotating in a wooden amplified cabinet.

name: lock
doc: Specifies whether delaytime is calculated relative to cps.

name: lrate
doc: Rate of modulation / rotation for leslie effect.

name: lsize
doc: Physical size of the cabinet in meters.

name: octave
doc: Sets the default octave of a synth.

name: panspan
doc: Controls how much multichannel output is fanned out.

name: pansplay
doc: Controls how much multichannel output is spread.

name: phaserdepth
doc: The amount the signal is affected by the phaser effect.

name: squiz
doc: Made by Calum Gunn.

name: unit
doc: Used in conjunction with speed, accepts values of "r" (rate, default behavior), "c" (cycles), or "s" (seconds).

name: filterHaps
doc: Returns a new Pattern, which only returns haps that meet the given test.

name: filterValues
doc: As with filterHaps, but the function is applied to values inside haps.
example:
const drums = s("bd sd bd sd")
kick: drums.filterValues((v) => v.s === 'bd').duck(2)
snare: drums.filterValues((v) => v.s === 'sd')
bass: s("saw!4").note("G#1").lpf(80).lpenv(4).orbit(2)
snippet:
const drums = s("bd sd bd sd")
kick: drums.filterValues((v) => v.s === 'bd').duck(2)
snare: drums.filterValues((v) => v.s === 'sd')
bass: s("saw!4").note("G#1").lpf(80).lpenv(4).orbit(2)

name: queryArc
doc: Query haps inside the given time span.

name: withHap
doc: As with withHaps, but applies the function to every hap, rather than every list of haps.

name: withHaps
doc: Returns a new pattern with the given function applied to the list of haps returned by every query.
